defs.def: a person who lives in a particular place or who has their home there 居民；住户

ex.t: 这是一种能量形式，把我失去的东西还给了我。

ex.s: People have been bringing their children in to see the hens and residents come and sit outside to watch them.
ex.t: 人们带着孩子来看母鸡，居民们也出来坐在外面观看它们。

ex.s: Wendy Wilson, extra care manager at 60 Penfold Street, one of the first to embark on the project, said: “Residents really welcome the idea of the project and the creative sessions.
ex.t: Penfold街60号的额外护理经理Wendy Wilson是最早参与该项目的人之一，她说："居民们非常欢迎这个项目和创意活动。

ex.s: It will really help connect our residents through a shared interest and creative activities.”
ex.t: 这真的会通过共同兴趣和创造性活动，帮助我们的住户建立联系。

ex.s: Fire extinguishers are located on each floor and in each apartment． Use a fire extinguisher only if you have been trained to do so． Irresponsible use of a fire extinguisher can create a dangerous situation for other residents and could result in damage to personal property． Misuse of a fire extinguisher will result in fines．
ex.t: 每层楼和每个公寓都配有灭火器。只有在受过训练时才可使用。不负责任地使用灭火器会给其他住户带来危险，并可能损坏个人财产。滥用灭火器将被罚款。

ex.s: Inhabitants of Boise, Idaho, watched with trepidation earlier this year as the city's oldest, tallest resident moved two blocks.
ex.t: 这家总部位于德克萨斯的公司开发并获得专利了一种挖掘和搬运技术来移动巨大的树木。

ex.s: SENIC DIVING: Swim with Farne’s most lovely residents: the thousands of grey seals that live on the island all year.
ex.t: 风景潜水：与法恩群岛最可爱的居民一起游泳——那些全年生活在岛上的成千上万只灰海豹。

ex.s: Residents here can online as easily as in large modern cities.
ex.t: 这里的居民可以像在现代化大城市里一样轻松地上网。

ex.s: For short , both residents and tourists can use the public bike system.
ex.t: 简言之，居民和游客都可以使用公共自行车系统。
